source_text.body:
Orchestrate the full research loop with parallel agents
Sakana's Agentic Scientist uses a scaffold of parallel agents to run the whole research loop, rather than one agent writing a paper.
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
The post announces the third version of Sakana's automated AI Scientist system, called the Agentic Scientist, and links to its GitHub repo. It says the design changed from a single agent writing a paper to a scaffold of parallel agents that orchestrates the full research loop. The post gives no detail on the individual agents' roles or on where people step in.
How it went
The post gives no results, numbers or evaluations, and no account of limitations. It is an announcement of the release only.
Worth knowing
For mechanics, setup steps and costs, read the linked GitHub repository, because the post itself says nothing about them.
Try it yourself
with
Manus
Copy prompt
I want to run a small research project on [research question or topic]. Split the work across parallel sub-agents: one surveying existing literature, one proposing hypotheses, one running analysis or experiments on [data or sources I can provide], and one drafting the write-up. Finish with a short report that cites its sources, lists what was tested and what was found, and flags weak points, and show me the plan before you start.
Original source: https://bsky.app/profile/hardmaru.bsky.social/post/3mxwc2dx6i22t
